_: Study 03 data. Every clickable thing on the round-4 wireframe, where it goes, and the pages that fall out. check.cjs tests this against rev4.html. Statuses: decided = Divya said so; proposed = my call, open to change; open = needs Kahran + Divya.

clickables.label: work
clickables.why: The only place every piece is visible at once. The homepage shows one at a time.

clickables.label: about
clickables.why: Rev 4 notes: who we are lives at about, off the homepage.

clickables.label: say hi
clickables.why: Rev 4 notes: the contact form lives at say hi.

clickables.label: the ___ in "We reimagine ___"
clickables.why: Not a link. It changes every 5 s; a moving target is a bad button, and it already mirrors the pill.

clickables.label: Newsletter
clickables.why: Someone deciding whether to subscribe wants to see an issue first. The heading is the natural door to past issues.

clickables.label: subscribe
clickables.why: Stays on the page: the form turns into a thank-you line. A whole page for 'thanks' sends them away from the work.

clickables.label: privacy line
clickables.why: Collecting emails needs a policy one click away.

clickables.label: the five pills
clickables.why: Rev 4 behaviour: a pill switches the panel, it does not leave the page. The same five reappear as filters on the work index.

clickables.label: the whole panel (image + sentence)
clickables.why: An experiment page when the Experiments pill is showing. Divya, round 3: no 'see the work'; the panel is the link. One page per piece, round 3.

clickables.label: tags in the panel
clickables.why: Plain text on the homepage. They sit inside the panel, which is already one big link; a link inside a link is invalid HTML and a mis-tap on a phone. They become links on the piece page.

clickables.label: client logo + name in the panel
clickables.why: Same reason as the tags: inside the panel link. The client page is reached from the piece page and the logo wall.

clickables.label: each client logo
clickables.why: A visitor who recognises a name wants everything we did for them. Klydo alone is seven pieces.

clickables.label: hello@joyus.studio
clickables.why: Opens their mail app. Not a page.

clickables.label: contact
clickables.why: Same destination as nav 'say hi'. Two labels for one page; worth renaming 'contact' to 'say hi' so they match.

clickables.label: Kahran
clickables.why: The map gives each founder history, current interests and find me: enough for a page.

clickables.label: podcast
clickables.why: The podcast already exists (podcast.html + ~80 episodes) and is outside this rebuild.

pages.title: Homepage
pages.note: Round 4. Gains real links in the final study.

pages.title: Piece page
pages.note: One piece of client work. The core page: every panel on the homepage lands here.

pages.title: Experiment page
pages.note: One experiment. No client; often something to play with.

pages.title: Client page
pages.note: Everything we did for one client, in the order we did it.

pages.title: Work index
pages.note: All 37 pieces. Pills and tags become filters here (/work/?pill=strategy, /work/?tag=investor-storytelling).

pages.title: About
pages.note: The Joyus story: artistic, strategic, innovative (from the map).

pages.title: Person page
pages.note: History, currently, find me (from the map).

pages.title: Newsletter
pages.note: Past issues + the signup. Includes the subscribed state.

pages.title: Privacy
pages.note: Short. Wireframed alongside the newsletter, which is the reason it exists.

pages.title: Podcast (existing)
pages.note: Kept as is. Outside this rebuild.
